name: com.coffeebean.login
description: Account login module for the CoffeeBean framework: pluggable provider (Google / Apple / Guest / custom) + pluggable backend (Firebase Auth by default, self-hosted server supported), account linking (guest -> real account), ID-token retrieval, and platform setup tooling. Firebase and Google Sign-In are OPTIONAL compile-time integrations: the module compiles and works without them (guest/email/custom providers), and lights up automatically when their packages are present. Depends on com.coffeebean.tools.

samples.description: 登录示例：游客登录 → 绑定 Google → 取 ID token → 登出（编辑器里用内置的模拟提供者跑通整套流程）。
